title: Bits, bytes and bases
instructions:
## Counting in twos and sixteens

Computers store everything as bits. This lab is arithmetic you can do on paper; the questions are checked instantly.

## Do this

Answer the questions on the right. For binary and hexadecimal answers, type just the digits (for example `1101` or `2F`).
hints: Group binary digits in fours from the right: 1111 = F, 1010 = A.
A kilobyte in computing is 1024 bytes; a byte is 8 bits.
